description: Use when the user asks which IP addresses or servers may send mail for a domain, or to flatten SPF. Returns every IPv4 and IPv6 block the record authorizes, with the include it came from. Analysis only. Ex: 'Which IPs may send mail as example.com?'. Free trial without an API key: a few calls a day.
